#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Map fitted parameters to SEB and batch the viewer geometry"
def fitted_parameters(fit):
    kind, count = fit["kind"], fit["segments"]
    p = fit["p"]
    dim = {"Rg": p[1]} if kind == "gaussian" else dimensions(
        kind, count, p[1], p[7] if len(p) > 7 else 1.)
    parameters = {f"{name}_segment": float(value) for name, value in dim.items()}
    parameters["beta_segment"] = (14667/2)*(.64-6.33)/(count or 1)
    volume = 4*np.pi*p[0]**3/3
    parameters.update(R_core=float(p[0]), R_anchor=float(p[0]+p[2]*p[1]),
                      beta_core=float(volume*(.34-6.33)*p[6]), beta_anchor=0.)
    return parameters


def compact_scene(traces):
    """Batch equal-material geometry for responsive full-micelle views."""
    batches = {}
    for trace in traces:
        color = trace.color if trace.type == "mesh3d" else trace.line.color
        key = (trace.type, color, trace.opacity)
        if key not in batches:
            batches[key] = dict(x=[], y=[], z=[], i=[], j=[], k=[])
        batch = batches[key]
        offset = len(batch["x"])
        for axis in ("x", "y", "z"):
            batch[axis].extend(getattr(trace, axis))
            if trace.type != "mesh3d":
                batch[axis].append(None)
        if trace.type == "mesh3d":
            for axis in ("i", "j", "k"):
                batch[axis].extend(int(index)+offset for index in getattr(trace, axis))
    result = []
    for (kind, color, opacity), batch in batches.items():
        if kind == "mesh3d":
            result.append(go.Mesh3d(**batch, color=color, opacity=opacity,
                                   showlegend=False, hoverinfo="skip"))
        else:
            result.append(go.Scatter3d(x=batch["x"], y=batch["y"], z=batch["z"],
                mode="lines", line={"color": color, "width": 5}, opacity=opacity,
                showlegend=False, hoverinfo="skip"))
    return result
